claims: Jessie Buckley is an Irish actress.
As of March 2026, Jessie Buckley has received two Academy Award nominations.
Jessie Buckley won the Best Actress Oscar in 2026 for her role as Agnes in Hamnet.
Jessie Buckley received her first Academy Award nomination for Best Supporting Actress for The Lost Daughter (2021).
In 2026, Jessie Buckley won Best Performance by an Actress in a Leading Role for Hamnet (as Agnes).
In 2022, Jessie Buckley was nominated for Best Performance by an Actress in a Supporting Role for The Lost Daughter (as Young Leda).
The Guardian notes that Jessie Buckley won the BAFTA for Best Actress for Hamnet.
The Guardian notes that Jessie Buckley won the Golden Globe for Best Actress for Hamnet.
